# The Rooiberg Wander

> A private, exclusive 3-night / 3-day slackpacking trail on foot through 15,000 hectares
> of malaria-free Big 5 mountain wilderness near Rooiberg, Limpopo, South Africa (the Waterberg),
> about 2.5 hours from OR Tambo International Airport. Tagline: "A luxury walking safari in the
> Waterberg".

## Key facts

- Format: a circuitous, point-to-point slackpacking trail. You walk while your luggage and
  provisions are moved between lodges each day, kept cool and dry. Self-catered (staff at each
  lodge help with cooking, the barbeque and cleanup) or fully catered.
- Duration: 3 nights / 3 days. No walking on the arrival day (Day 1); depart immediately after
  the final walk on Day 4.
- Walking: three days of 15 to 20 km each, about 55 km in total.
- Terrain: the Groenkop and Elandsberg mountains, with deep kloofs, riverbeds and open savanna
  plains. Grading: moderate to challenging; a good level of hiking fitness is required.
- Malaria: 100% malaria-free.
- Group: an exclusive buyout runs Wednesday or Thursday only, for exactly 8 guests, self-catered
  or catered, with sole exclusive use of the trail and each safari lodge overnight. On every
  other day, a shared/flexible departure is available: the first booking on a date opens it at 4
  or more people and sets that date's catering (self-catered or catered); later bookings top up
  in 2s or more, matching that catering, up to 8 guests in total.
- Safety: the Two-Man Rule. Two experienced trail guides accompany you at all times.
- Wildlife: a Big 5 reserve with more than 66 mammal species (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo,
  cheetah, giraffe, plus wide-ranging plains game) and over 168 recorded bird species.
- Safari lodges (each with a swimming pool, equipped kitchen, refrigeration, barbeque, safe
  drinking water and free WiFi): Temminck's Lodge (valley basecamp, start & end), Oukraal (bush
  lodge, Night 2), ViervanAcht (mountain lodge, Night 3).
- Route: begins and ends at Temminck's Lodge. Over Groenkop to Oukraal (Day 2); up the high
  ridges via L-Kloof to ViervanAcht by way of the Welgedacht lookout, with views over Marakele
  (Day 3); across the plains along the Sand River back to Temminck's Lodge (Day 4).
- Price (no VAT is charged): priced per person per night for every departure, exclusive buyout or
  shared. Self-catered from R1,100 pp/night midweek (R1,500 pp/night on a Thursday/Friday start
  in high season); catered from R4,800 pp/night, any start day. Rates are about 20% lower outside
  the high season (1 April to 31 October, and 15 December to 15 January). A self-catered booking
  made 8 to 21 days before arrival gets a 22% discount. Includes accommodation, two experienced
  trail guides, daily baggage transport, lodge staff and all conservation levies. Excludes travel
  to and from Temminck's Lodge and personal travel insurance; food and beverages are excluded
  unless the catered option is chosen.
- Payment: full payment is due 45 days before arrival and is non-refundable thereafter. Bookings
  made 45 or more days out pay a 50% deposit now, with the balance due at the 45-day mark.
- Booking window: online bookings are accepted for start dates from 15 January 2027, and up to 18
  months ahead for catered trips or 8 months ahead for self-catered trips. The trail is currently
  in beta testing; dates before 15 January 2027 are available to family and friends by enquiry or
  WhatsApp only, at a discount.
- Contact: Hanlie, WhatsApp +27 82 905 8832, office hours 08h00 to 17h00.

## Location

Near Rooiberg, Limpopo, South Africa, in the Waterberg region close to Marakele. About 2.5 hours
from OR Tambo International Airport.
